summary_rationale: Manorama Industries has successfully transitioned from a low-margin forest-seed trader into a vertically integrated specialty-fats and Cocoa Butter Equivalent (CBE) manufacturer with 47,500 MTPA fractionation capacity at Birkoni, proprietary Indian tribal and West African shea sourcing, and 3-to-5-year OEM approvals from global confectionery and cosmetic leaders. Revenue scaled nearly 9.4x from FY17 to ₹1,367 Cr in FY26 (₹1,617 Cr TTM) with 26.4% operating margins, 34.9% ROCE, and a decisive cash-flow inflection in FY26 (CFO +₹250 Cr, 92% CFO/EBITDA, FCF +₹196 Cr) reinforced by a ₹500 Cr QIP. KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH due to structurally high seasonal inventory days (369 days in FY26 vs 518 in FY25), recurring H1 working-capital debt spikes (₹518 Cr in Sep 2026), single-site Birkoni plant concentration, and West African Sahel procurement exposure.
